# Rate Limiting Performance

## Problem
High-traffic endpoints show increased latency under burst conditions.

## Analysis
- Token bucket algorithm with 100 req/min per client
- Burst handling adds ~5ms overhead per request
- Redis-backed counter implementation

## Recommendations
- Increase burst limit to 150 req/min for premium tier
- Consider sliding window for more accurate throttling
